text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~ fufun♪
Oh my~, Trainer-sama~.
Good morning~.
choice_data_list: In a good mood this morning, aren't you?
You're in high spirits this morning, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, taking advantage of the time off I received,
I had a picnic with
Sister Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Spending relaxing time while basking in the sunlight—
catching up on stories, enjoying lunch,
working out together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was able to have a truly meaningful vacation.
Thank you so very much~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, I am ready to handle any training menu you throw at me,
so please, feel free to command me as you wish~♪
Mejiro Bright made good use of her day off and seems to have refreshed herself considerably!
